questions.question_text: A company has 40 employees whose names are listed in a certain order. Then, the average bonus, in rupees, of all the 40 employees together in the year 2023 was

We have 40 employees in a specific order, and we need to find their average bonus in 2023 after certain changes.

What we know for 2022:

First 30 employees: average bonus = Rs. 40000

Last 30 employees: average bonus = Rs. 60000

First 10 + Last 10 employees: average bonus = Rs. 50000

What changes in 2023:

First 10 employees: bonus increases by 100% (doubles)

Last 10 employees: bonus increases by 200% (triples)

Middle 20 employees: bonus unchanged

We think of the 40 employees as three overlapping groups:

Group A: Employees 1-10 (first 10)

Group B: Employees 11-30 (middle 20)

Group C: Employees 31-40 (last 10)

The given information talks about "first 30" (A+B), "last 30" (B+C), and "first 10 + last 10" (A+C). This grouping helps us use all the given information systematically.

Let's call their total bonuses in 2022: aaa, bbb, and ccc respectively.

Total = Average × Number of people

From the given information:

First 30 employees (A + B): a+b=30×40000=1200000a + b = 30 × 40000 = 1200000a+b=30×40000=1200000

Last 30 employees (B + C): b+c=30×60000=1800000b + c = 30 × 60000 = 1800000b+c=30×60000=1800000

First 10 + Last 10 (A + C): a+c=20×50000=1000000a + c = 20 × 50000 = 1000000a+c=20×50000=1000000

We have three equations:

  1. a+b=1200000a + b = 1200000a+b=1200000
  2. b+c=1800000b + c = 1800000b+c=1800000
  3. a+c=1000000a + c = 1000000a+c=1000000

Instead of solving one by one, let's add all three equations:

(a+b)+(b+c)+(a+c)=1200000+1800000+1000000(a + b) + (b + c) + (a + c) = 1200000 + 1800000 + 1000000(a+b)+(b+c)+(a+c)=1200000+1800000+1000000

2a+2b+2c=40000002a + 2b + 2c = 40000002a+2b+2c=4000000

a+b+c=2000000a + b + c = 2000000a+b+c=2000000

When we add all three equations, each variable appears exactly twice, so we get 2(a+b+c)2(a + b + c)2(a+b+c).

Now we can find each group's total:

From equation 2: a=(a+b+c)−(b+c)=2000000−1800000=200000a = (a + b + c) - (b + c) = 2000000 - 1800000 = 200000a=(a+b+c)−(b+c)=2000000−1800000=200000

From equation 1: c=(a+b+c)−(a+b)=2000000−1200000=800000c = (a + b + c) - (a + b) = 2000000 - 1200000 = 800000c=(a+b+c)−(a+b)=2000000−1200000=800000

From equation 3: b=(a+b+c)−(a+c)=2000000−1000000=1000000b = (a + b + c) - (a + c) = 2000000 - 1000000 = 1000000b=(a+b+c)−(a+c)=2000000−1000000=1000000

100% increase means bonus becomes double (original + 100% of original = 2 × original)

200% increase means bonus becomes triple (original + 200% of original = 3 × original)

Group A (employees 1-10):

New sum = 200000×2=400000200000 × 2 = 400000200000×2=400000

Group B (employees 11-30):

Sum remains = 100000010000001000000

Group C (employees 31-40):

New sum = 800000×3=2400000800000 × 3 = 2400000800000×3=2400000

Total sum in 2023 = 400000+1000000+2400000=3800000400000 + 1000000 + 2400000 = 3800000400000+1000000+2400000=3800000

Average bonus in 2023 = 380000040=95000\dfrac{3800000}{40} = 95000403800000​=95000

Answer: Rs. 95000

Substituting A+V=2A + V = 2A+V=2:

75(2)+60V+45S=30075(2) + 60V + 45S = 30075(2)+60V+45S=300

150+60V+45S=300150 + 60V + 45S = 300150+60V+45S=300

135+15V=150135 + 15V = 150135+15V=150

15V=1515V = 1515V=15

∴V=1∴ V = 1∴V=1 unit per day

Finding others:

Since A+V=2A + V = 2A+V=2 and V=1V = 1V=1: A=1A = 1A=1 unit per day

Since V+S=3V + S = 3V+S=3 and V=1V = 1V=1: S=2S = 2S=2 units per day

questions.question_text: Bina incurs 19% loss when she sells a product at Rs. 4860 to Shyam, who in turn sells this product to Hari. If Bina would have sold this product to Shyam at the purchase price of Hari, she would have obtained 17% profit. Then, the profit, in rupees, made by Shyam is

Bina sells to Shyam at Rs. 4860 (19% loss for Bina)

Shyam then sells to Hari at some price

Loss = 19% of 100x100x100x = 19x19x19x

Selling price = Cost price - Loss = 100x−19x=81x100x - 19x = 81x100x−19x=81x

We know this selling price equals Rs. 4860:

81x=486081x = 486081x=4860

x=4860÷81=60x = 4860 ÷ 81 = 60x=4860÷81=60

Therefore, Bina's cost price = 100x=100×60=Rs. 6000100x = 100 × 60 = \text{Rs. } 6000100x=100×60=Rs. 6000

The key insight here: "If Bina would have sold this product to Shyam at the purchase price of Hari, she would have obtained 17% profit."

Selling price = Cost price + Profit = 6000+1020=Rs. 70206000 + 1020 = \text{Rs. } 70206000+1020=Rs. 7020

Therefore, Shyam's profit is Rs. 2160.
